hints.title: Uploaded State Tracking
hints.text: Maintain a boolean array or set marking which video numbers have been uploaded so far.

hints.title: Monotonic Pointer Advance
hints.text: Store a pointer to the current longest uploaded prefix. The prefix length can only increase monotonically over time.

hints.title: Consecutive Extension
hints.text: Whenever a video is uploaded, advance the longest prefix pointer as long as the next video index is also marked as uploaded.

hints.title: Monotonic Prefix Pointer Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) amortized per upload, O(1) for longest
complexity.notes: The pointer moves forward at most n times across all operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning from 1 upward on each query takes O(n) per query.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Boolean array of size n + 2 provides constant-time lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains a monotonic pointer that only advances forward to achieve amortized O(1).
